title: Scientists call for international body to oversee advanced AI
script:
Four hundred scientists are calling for a new international body to govern advanced AI.
This coalition wants a global agency to oversee safety and prevent misuse.
Signatories include pioneers like Yoshua Bengio who seek tighter international standards.
They urge countries to establish binding agreements rather than relying on voluntary corporate pledges.
This call for action follows significant concerns about the rapid pace of development.
The group argues that national regulation cannot manage risks that cross borders.
Do you trust international bodies to regulate technology?
